homePage.title: Learn English at home!
homePage.description: Study with certified teachers, a personal approach, interactive tasks and practice. From A1 to C1, we will guide you.

homePage.step3Description: Join video lessons and complete interactive tasks.

coursesPage.title: Our programs
coursesPage.description: Choose your level from beginner A1 to advanced C1. Our courses follow CEFR standards.
coursesPage.beginnerText: Understands and uses simple everyday phrases. Can introduce themselves and ask simple questions.
coursesPage.intermediateText: Can handle most situations, express ideas clearly and describe events.
coursesPage.advancedText: Expresses ideas freely and creates clear texts on complex topics.
coursesPage.unsureText: Take the level test, and we will suggest the best option.

teachersPage.description: Choose a teacher who will help you move confidently toward your goal.

pricingPage.title: Pricing
pricingPage.description: Choose the ideal plan for your learning. All plans include access to teachers and study materials.

aboutPage.title: Who LinguaFirst is
aboutPage.description: Our mission is to make quality English learning available to everyone, everywhere.
aboutPage.missionText: We help people master English for education, careers and international communication.
aboutPage.visionText: To become a strong online English platform with modern methods and motivating teachers.
aboutPage.historyText: Since 2015, LinguaFirst has grown from a small teaching team into an international community of students and teachers.
valueItems: Every decision starts with student success

We build a friendly learning environment
